name: screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot on the local X11 desktop: the full screen, a single window (by title substring or window id), or a list of currently open windows. Uses ImageMagick's `import` when available, otherwise ffmpeg's x11grab.

mode.description: What to capture: 'full' (whole screen, default), 'window' (one window), or 'list' (enumerate open windows without capturing).

window.description: For mode 'window': a window title substring (matched with xdotool) or a window id (decimal, or hex like 0x1a00004).

output_path.description: File to write. Optional for 'full' and 'window'; defaults to screenshot_<timestamp>.<ext> in the current working directory.

format.description: Output format: png (default), jpg, or webp. Overrides the output_path extension when given.

quality.description: JPEG/WEBP quality (1-100, default 95). Ignored for PNG.
